answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 10786 Country: India Title: Is divorce valid if sent by an email. Question: Is divorce valid if sent by an email. Answer ID: 10786 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 214/214=M/1429) If, due to absence of wife, talaq (divorce) was sent by email and the husband confesses that he sent the Talaq by email or he asked someone to send it by email, then the Talaq will take place. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
